applicability: The public provider page and every tracked inbound reference to it.
conditions: The page is read as the current description of the retired providers.
exclusions: Unrelated content on the same pages.
An invitation to opt into a provider setup that no longer exists.

statement: The public provider page is a retirement and cleanup account, and every verified inbound link describes that retirement instead of promising an opt-in provider setup.
